narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Bars always stand up straight, so I will use vertical bars.
<bookmark mark='flat'/>A bar graph can lie down too, with bars running sideways.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Ask which way the thing is measured, and let the bars follow it.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says bars always stand up straight, so vertical bars; a bar standing up is shown beside the rope lying flat; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='steps'/>Find each continent's longest river, write the lengths in a table, and draw sideways bars.
<bookmark mark='check'/>To check your graph, make sure the longest bar belongs to the longest river in your table.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the steps: find each continent's longest river, write the lengths in a table, draw the bars sideways, check the longest bar

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says bars always stand up straight, so he will use vertical bars. A river's length lies along the ground, so sideways bars match it better, and the bubble is struck.
